Context: 6. Relaxations and concessions.-

- (v) Special Concessions for Disabled Ex-Servicemen.If the disability is attributed to military service, he will be accorded Priority-I along with a retrenched employee for appointment to Groups 'C' and MTS posts filled by direct recruitmerit. Up to two members, each of the families of defence service personnel (widow, son/ daughter/ near relative who agree to support the family) will be granted priority immediately after the disabled Ex-Servicemen, i.e., Priority II-A.
